verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of free or trial access is an "Anonymous Tier" of the Consensus MCP server, documented as intended for trying the server before signing up. It is rate-limited and serves the agent/MCP surface rather than the researcher-facing web app. The pricing page excerpts mention Deep Searches and centralized billing but say nothing about a free plan or its limits. Missing for 10: documented free tier or trial for the web app, stated free-tier usage limits (searches, Deep Searches, Consensus Meter), and independent or hands-on confirmation that free use is meaningful for research.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can try the product meaningfully on a free tier or trial

citations.quote: Intended for trying the MCP server before signing up, not for production traffic
